proposal.reason: Main change is in **network**: NET/CollNet selection, initialization, lifetime, and proxy/backend operations move from process-global state to per-communicator state (with PCCL_NET override and per-comm plugin handling). **communicator** is additionally needed because comm config/lifecycle now owns netName/backend fields and enforces parent-child shared-resource backend consistency. **device-topology** is needed for substantive per-backend topology behavior (EIC/NIC handling and PXN gating tied to selected net). **graph-search** is needed because graph comparison/selection logic now depends on topology’s per-comm EIC state and updated PXN-disable API usage. **memory** is needed because U2MM/host allocation and shared-memory creation now depend on the communicator-selected net backend for properties/NUMA behavior.
